notes.title: New update 9.7
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26004345/88ec5c989256508fe78de7263fa4617cba975f9f.png[/img]
Ahoy Captains!
It's been a while since we last published an update for The Pirate: Caribbean Hunt.    Alas there is a change in the wind! We are pleased to announce that update version 9.7 is dawning on the horizon! 

While this update focuses on an engine upgrade supporting overall functionality & performance, we are also happy to present to you some new things such as; UI additions, improvements to graphic & sound FX, improved game mechanics such as AI behavior, as well as many other improvements & bug fixes.

Be sure to check out the new features and additions including but not limited to:
[list]
[*] New gunport door painting in the ship customizations.
[*]Modifications and improvements made to; Santisima Trinidad, HMS Sovereign of the Seas & the HMS Duke of Kent ships.
[*]The new ability to set anchor without the need to open the map after attacking or defending a base or port.
[*]New calaculated awards for flawless victories & total death kills in Multiplayer mode.
[*]Improved rules & mechanics for Multiplayer mode playability.
[*]Auto refresh for the Multiplayer mode lobby list.
[*]The option to change your ship in the lobby window.
[*]The removal of the personal ban list in Multiplayer mode.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 9.0
notes.content:
Ahoy pirates! Long time no sea (get the joke?). This time we have a big surprise – a new content update for The Pirate: Caribbean Hunt! 9.0 version brings story add-on called “A Siren’s Chilling Melody” made by community’s favorite, one and only: Charles Horn. Strap in for a new adventures of your fearless captain, bring down maleficent King Philip III, discover new location, and maybe you’ll get a chance to find a love of your life? Without further spoilers, there is also a nice surprise at the end of the campaign you can capture a free premium ship with a bit of a luck and a pirate skill.
To play “A Siren’s Chilling Melody” you’ll need to finish “Jewel of the Caribbean” campaign first, and obtain the Brazil maps.
In this update we’ve also increased the limit of ships to 5 (for Commodore II skill) and fixed a lot of bugs.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26004345/a98449b181a55b808875e8248d6510b083255304.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 8.6
notes.content:
The Pirate: Caribbean Hunt 8.6 update is now live! Can you recall the board game Battleship from your school days? We implemented our own take on it as a mini-game launched from multiplayer mode. Just join or create a session to have some fun and earn extra gold. We’ve also added a new tier 4 frigate ship. It’s free - you can encounter her on missions, towns and while sailing in the open world after having unlocked the Florida map.
We also balanced some ships and fixed bugs from single and multiplayer modes.
Have fun!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26004345/8c7c0466f3016e74de4488c26d3308c5bfc7ce1c.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26004345/7376b1f80a6252501937c531aebbf893942eb969.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 8.5
notes.content:
The long awaited 8.5 update for The Pirate: Caribbean Hunt is now available!
To give the game a unique look, you can now enable in the Settings menu “Cinematic FX” filters. Customizable adjustment to each time of day and weather is now available. But that’s not all. You can adjust each filter separately to make your game look more grim or colorful. Just give it a try before we announce the screenshot contest next week. Stay tuned!
We are also introducing two new modes in multiplayer. First mode is multi-tiered ship racing. This is a fun new mode where you can test your captain skills to make the best time to the finish line. And the wind is not your only enemy... We hope that you’ll feel a retro Mario Kart vibe in this mode.
The Second mode is dedicated to our die-hard multiplayer fans – it is a separate Tier-6 made specifically for the large fortress ships. This is intended to prevent inhibition of max potential of the other tier 5 ships.

As with the The Pirate: Plague of the Dead, thanks to our friends from UNLOCTEAM (https://unlocteam.com) we are introducing Russian and Ukrainian Voice-Overs. You can switch between Russian, Ukrainian and English in Language section in the main menu.

This update also features some additions to your UI and the highly requested rescaling of the Santisima Trinidad premium ship, and the addition of more cannons to the Sovereign of the Seas and HMS Tonnant.
Enjoy the game, especially two new multiplayer modes!

notes.title: 2nd anniversary giveaway and a new update
notes.content:
On January 3rd 2016 The Pirate: Caribbean Hunt debuted on mobile devices. Since then, around the game gathered a great and passionate community which has supported us all along. We managed to reach over 8 million players across all platforms. We’d like to humbly thank you for that.
There is no better celebration for a birthday than a giveaway and a new update. Every player that will log-in to the game before this Friday (9AM PST, HNG cloud save required) will receive a free premium ship "Calypso" (one per individual account).
We’ve also prepared the new update (8.4) that contains a new premium Tier 5 military junk called Emperor's Mistress with a total number of 151 guns. In this update we are introducing the new logo, icon, 2x speed in multiplayer, bug fixes, improvements on some ships and the option to replay the "Jewel of the Caribbean" side quest to obtain another permanent port.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26004345/99f8b776096e4125c380f00f7d150a5e8123855b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 8.3
notes.content:
Version 8.3 update for The Pirate: Caribbean Hunt is now live! It introduces a long awaited Chinese Junk. There are two versions of the ship – free and premium!
It’s a custom design based on drawings and models of pirate junks from the 18th century. Her main advantages are speed and maneuverability.
In this update we also rebalanced and tweaked all military and civil class ships to improve AI behavior and balanced difficulty levels.
Please mind that the free non premium junk is a tier-4 ship, and it only becomes available after unlocking the fourth map (Bahamas) as this affects difficulty level. Their locations are random – you can encounter them in the open world or during a mission, or buy them in cities.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26004345/69d87ab1b0f458e386cda15a85c2bace768d3864.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 8.2
notes.content:
Update version 8.2 for The Pirate: Caribbean Hunt is now available! Introducing the epic HMS Duke of Kent premium ship, with 190 cannons on board. The Royal Navy planned to build what would have been Britain and possibly the World’s largest ship of war, sadly she was never built. Four years after the Battle of Trafalgar and the fall of the Santisima Trinidad to the much smaller and less heavily armed vessel HMS Neptune, prompted reconsideration for the construction of this ship.
We’ve also implemented a lot of fixes and we optimized the code. Game now supports anti-aliasing (just set quality for good or higher in the game launcher). We’ve also rebalanced some ships – mostly 1st and 2nd rates, this includes the non premium ships as well. A few changes were made in multiplayer mode, the option to view all ships per "settings" option in multiplayer. This means you no longer will have to bulk your ships together at one port, resulting in improved FPS and reduced lag. Clock stopper bug also fixed. Compass is now visible in the spyglass mode.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26004345/e8a3a97002a0b8bb7461fbe292638ae5723a9d31.jpg[/img][url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26004345/e8a3a97002a0b8bb7461fbe292638ae5723a9d31.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26004345/3cf5c5d56b86b1f7527b4793505df570235521c1.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: New "The Pirate" game !!!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Captains![/b][/h1]
It is with great pleasure that we present to you The Pirate: Plague of the Dead. You can already install this new installment in The Pirate series. 
The game features a fully open world with dynamic day and night cycle, and undead captains with unique skills, including the much-requested summoning of the mighty kraken. We didn’t forget about unique ship designs, which fit the dark mood of the game perfectly. These are just several new features of Plague of the Dead.
